योगे स्थानङ्गतवति बलिनश्चन्द्रे स्वं वा तनुगृहमथवा।
पापैदृष्टे बलवति मरणं वर्षस्यान्ते किल मुनिगदितम् ।। 12 ।।
In the above shlokas where the death of the child is stated
to be soon after birth as a result of the aspect on Moon of
malefic planets it takes place within a year of birth in transit
after birth, the Moon gets into the influence of the malefics etc
causing the said yoga or when it occupies the same place as in
the birth chart or is in the lagna again.
